description.zh: 救世基督像矗立于里约热内卢科科瓦多山顶，高38米（含底座），双臂展开28米，俯瞰整个城市和瓜纳巴拉湾。1931年落成，是世界新七大奇迹之一。
description.en: Christ the Redeemer stands 38 m tall (including base) atop Corcovado mountain, arms outstretched 28 m, gazing over Rio and Guanabara Bay. Completed in 1931 and one of the New Seven Wonders of the World.

location.zh: 里约热内卢科科瓦多山

zh: 高38米（含底座98米），里约热内卢最著名地标
张开双臂俯瞰瓜纳巴拉湾全景
en: 38 m tall statue (98 m including pedestal); Rio's defining landmark
One of the New Seven Wonders of the World

admission.zh: 约98巴西雷亚尔（含齿轨电车或小巴）

tips.zh: 提前网上预约门票；雾天视野差，晴天出行。可选择步行2小时山路减少等待，但较为耗体力。
tips.en: Book tickets online in advance. Go on a clear day — fog can obscure the statue and views entirely. The 2-hour hike up avoids queues but is strenuous.

description.zh: 亚马逊是世界上最大的热带雨林，覆盖面积超过550万平方公里，是地球上超过10%物种的家园。从玛瑙斯出发可进行深度雨林探险，体验原始的热带生态系统。
description.en: The Amazon is the world's largest tropical rainforest, covering over 5.5 million km2 and home to more than 10% of all Earth's species. Manaus is the gateway for deep-jungle expeditions.

location.zh: 亚马逊州，巴西北部

zh: 世界上最大的热带雨林，占地550万平方公里
全球物种多样性最丰富的地区，有超过40,000种植物
亚马逊河是世界流量最大的河流
en: World's largest tropical rainforest; 5.5 million km²
Earth's most biodiverse region with over 40,000 plant species
Amazon River carries more water than any other river on Earth

admission.zh: 自助游需导游，费用因线路而异（约500—2,000美元/人/周）

tips.zh: 马瑙斯（Manaus）是深入亚马逊最便捷的出发地；7—10月（旱季）陆路探险更容易，11—6月洪水期则以船游为主。
tips.en: Manaus is the most accessible gateway. July–October (dry season) is better for land-based exploration; the flood season (November–June) means boat-based touring.

description.zh: 伊瓜苏瀑布横跨巴西和阿根廷边境，是世界上最宽的瀑布群，由275条瀑布组成，宽约2,700米。巴西侧可欣赏到全景，阿根廷侧则可近距离感受「魔鬼咽喉」的震撼。
description.en: Iguazu Falls straddles the Brazil-Argentina border — the world's widest waterfall system, with 275 falls stretching 2,700 m. Brazil's side gives the panoramic view; Argentina's side puts you inside the Devil's Throat.

location.zh: 巴拉那州，巴西南部

zh: 世界最宽瀑布群，宽约2,700米，拥有275条瀑布
巴西侧可俯瞰全景，阿根廷侧可走入瀑布中间
「恶魔的咽喉」（Devil's Throat）是最壮观的单条瀑布
en: World's widest waterfall system; ~2,700 m wide with 275 falls
Brazil side for the panorama; Argentina side to walk among the falls
Devil's Throat — the most thunderous single cascade

admission.zh: 巴西侧约75巴西雷亚尔，阿根廷侧约5,000阿根廷比索

tips.zh: 两侧都值得游览，多数人选择住在巴西的福斯-杜伊瓜苏或阿根廷的伊瓜苏港，跨境便捷。
tips.en: Visit both sides if possible — each offers a completely different perspective. Foz do Iguaçu (Brazil) or Puerto Iguazú (Argentina) are the main bases, with easy border crossings.

description.zh: 里约狂欢节是全球最盛大的狂欢节，每年吸引超过200万人参与街头庆典。桑巴舞校在桑巴大道的巡游是其核心活动，华丽的服装、激昂的音乐和热情的舞蹈令全世界为之倾倒。
description.en: Rio Carnival is the world's largest, drawing over 2 million street revellers. The centrepiece is the samba school parade on the Sambadrome, a riot of elaborate costumes, thunderous drums and passionate dance.

location.zh: 里约热内卢市

zh: 全球最大的狂欢节，每年逾200万人涌入街头
桑巴舞校在桑巴馆的表演堪称艺术巅峰
里约科帕卡巴纳和伊帕内玛海滩是狂欢中心
en: World's largest carnival; over 2 million people in the streets daily
Samba school parades at the Sambadrome — a peak of artistic spectacle
Copacabana and Ipanema beaches are the centre of the street party

admission.zh: 桑巴馆门票约120—2,000美元（视位置而定）

tips.zh: 狂欢节通常在2月或3月举行（复活节前40天），机票和酒店须提前至少6个月预订。
tips.en: Carnival falls in February or March (40 days before Easter). Book flights and hotels at least 6 months in advance — prices and demand are extreme during the event.

description.zh: 欧鲁普雷图是巴西巴洛克建筑的杰出代表，18世纪黄金热潮时期曾是殖民地最繁荣的城市。石板街道、教堂和雕塑艺术家阿莱雅迪尼奥的杰作遍布全城，1980年被列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Ouro Preto is the finest example of Brazilian Baroque architecture, once the most prosperous colonial city during the 18th-century gold rush. Cobblestone streets, ornate churches and the masterworks of sculptor Aleijadinho fill this UNESCO World Heritage city inscribed in 1980.

location.zh: 米纳斯吉拉斯州，巴西东南部

zh: 18世纪巴西黄金时代最完整的殖民城市
雕塑家阿莱雅迪尼奥（Aleijadinho）的巴洛克杰作遍布全城
蜿蜒石板街道与色彩斑斓的教堂构成梦幻景观
en: Brazil's most complete 18th-century gold-rush colonial city
Baroque masterworks by sculptor Aleijadinho throughout the town
Winding cobblestone streets and ornate churches in a hilltop setting

admission.zh: 大部分教堂收取少量门票，约10—20巴西雷亚尔
admission.en: Most churches charge a small fee ~BRL$10–20 each

tips.zh: 从贝洛奥里藏特乘巴士约2小时可达；周末人流较多，建议工作日前往。注意石板路崎岖，穿舒适的步行鞋。
tips.en: About 2 hours by bus from Belo Horizonte. Visit on a weekday to avoid weekend crowds. Cobblestones are uneven — wear comfortable walking shoes.

description.zh: 奥林达是巴西东北部最重要的殖民城市之一，建于16世纪，以葡萄牙殖民时期的巴洛克教堂、五彩斑斓的历史建筑和著名的狂欢节著称。1982年被列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Olinda is one of Brazil's most important colonial cities, founded in the 16th century and celebrated for its Portuguese Baroque churches, brightly coloured historic buildings and famous Carnival. It was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1982.

location.zh: 伯南布哥州，巴西东北部

zh: 16世纪葡萄牙殖民时期完整保存的历史区
20多座色彩鲜艳的巴洛克教堂点缀山丘之上
以独特的「弗雷沃」（frevo）舞蹈和狂欢节著称
en: Over 20 brightly painted Baroque churches dotting its hills
Known for its unique frevo dance style and vibrant Carnival

admission.zh: 历史区免费游览，各教堂收费约5—15巴西雷亚尔
admission.en: Historic district free to walk; individual churches ~BRL$5–15

tips.zh: 紧邻累西腓（Recife），可作为半日游。2月狂欢节期间的弗雷沃舞游行是巴西最独特的狂欢节庆典之一。
tips.en: Located next to Recife and easily visited as a half-day trip. The frevo dance parade during February Carnival is one of Brazil's most distinctive Carnival celebrations.

name.zh: 耶稣会传教区遗址（巴西部分）

description.zh: 圣米格尔·达斯米松伊斯是巴西境内保存最完好的耶稣会传教遗址，建于17—18世纪，是耶稣会修士与瓜拉尼印第安人共同建立的乌托邦式社区的历史见证。与阿根廷共同列入UNESCO世界遗产（1983年）。
description.en: São Miguel das Missões is the best-preserved Jesuit mission in Brazil, built in the 17th–18th centuries as a utopian community of Jesuit priests and Guaraní people. It is inscribed jointly with Argentina as a UNESCO World Heritage Site (1983).

location.zh: 南里奥格兰德州，巴西南部
location.en: Rio Grande do Sul state, southern Brazil

zh: 保存最完好的耶稣会传教遗址，展示独特的巴洛克-瓜拉尼艺术风格
每晚举行的灯光秀将传教历史娓娓道来
附近的小博物馆收藏珍贵的原住民雕塑
en: Best-preserved Jesuit mission ruin showcasing unique Baroque-Guaraní art
Nightly sound and light show tells the story of the missions
On-site museum with rare indigenous Guaraní sculptures

admission.zh: 约20巴西雷亚尔；灯光秀另收费

tips.zh: 圣米格尔·达斯米松伊斯距桑托安赫洛约50公里，建议自驾或包车前往，公共交通班次有限。
tips.en: São Miguel das Missões is ~50 km from Santo Ângelo. A rental car or private transfer is recommended as public transport is infrequent.

name.en: Historic Centre of Salvador da Bahia

description.zh: 萨尔瓦多是巴西第一座殖民地首都，历史中心（佩洛里尼奥）以其色彩缤纷的葡萄牙殖民建筑、非洲裔巴西文化和卡波耶拉武术著称。1985年列入UNESCO世界遗产，是拉丁美洲非洲文化保存最完好的地方之一。
description.en: Salvador was Brazil's first colonial capital. Its historic centre (Pelourinho) is celebrated for colourful Portuguese colonial architecture, Afro-Brazilian culture and capoeira. Inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1985, it is one of Latin America's finest repositories of African heritage.

location.zh: 巴伊亚州，巴西东北部

zh: 佩洛里尼奥广场：色彩缤纷的殖民建筑与非洲裔巴西文化融合
卡波耶拉（Capoeira）武术表演随处可见
圣弗朗西斯科教堂内布满黄金装饰，华美绝伦
en: Pelourinho square: colourful colonial buildings infused with Afro-Brazilian culture
Capoeira street performances throughout the historic district
Igreja de São Francisco — interior lavished with gilded woodwork

admission.zh: 历史区免费；各景点收费约10—30巴西雷亚尔
admission.en: Historic district free to explore; individual sites ~BRL$10–30

tips.zh: 周二是佩洛里尼奥传统鼓乐（Olodum）表演之夜，气氛最为热烈。注意贵重物品，部分街道夜间需格外谨慎。
tips.en: Tuesday evening is the traditional Olodum drumming night in Pelourinho — the most atmospheric time to visit. Keep valuables secure; some streets require extra caution after dark.

name.en: Sanctuary of Bom Jesus do Congonhas

description.zh: 孔戈尼亚斯善主圣殿是巴西最重要的朝圣地，以雕塑家阿莱雅迪尼奥创作的12位先知皂石雕像和7座苦路小礼拜堂闻名于世。这组18世纪晚期的宗教杰作被誉为拉丁美洲巴洛克艺术的顶峰，1985年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: The Sanctuary of Bom Jesus do Congonhas is Brazil's most important pilgrimage site, famed for Aleijadinho's 12 soapstone Prophets and seven Passion chapels. This late-18th-century masterpiece is considered the pinnacle of Latin American Baroque art, inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1985.

location.zh: 米纳斯吉拉斯州，巴西东南部

zh: 阿莱雅迪尼奥雕刻的12尊先知皂石像，是拉丁美洲最伟大的巴洛克雕塑
7座展现耶稣受难场景的小礼拜堂，内有彩绘木质人物群像
巴西最重要的天主教朝圣地之一
en: Aleijadinho's 12 soapstone Prophets — the finest Baroque sculptures in Latin America
Seven Passion chapels with polychrome wooden figures depicting the Stations of the Cross
One of Brazil's most important Catholic pilgrimage destinations

admission.zh: 免费参观（可自愿捐款）

tips.zh: 距欧鲁普雷图约80公里，可与欧鲁普雷图合并为一日游行程。清晨光线最佳，可拍摄到先知雕像的绝美照片。
tips.en: About 80 km from Ouro Preto — combine the two in a single-day itinerary. Early morning light is best for photographing the Prophet statues.

description.zh: 巴西利亚是巴西的首都，建于1956—1960年，是20世纪城市规划与现代主义建筑最重要的实验之一。由城市规划师卢西奥·科斯塔和建筑师奥斯卡·尼迈耶共同设计，从空中俯瞰形如飞机或弓箭，1987年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Brasília is Brazil's purpose-built capital, constructed 1956–1960 and one of the 20th century's most significant experiments in urban planning and modernist architecture. Designed by Lúcio Costa and Oscar Niemeyer, it resembles a plane or bow from the air and was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1987.

location.zh: 联邦区，巴西中部

zh: 国家大教堂：尼迈耶设计的标志性桂冠形玻璃建筑
三权广场：总统府、国会大厦与最高法院构成权力中心
从电视塔俯瞰城市的飞机形布局
en: Metropolitan Cathedral — Niemeyer's iconic crown-shaped glass structure
Three Powers Plaza — Palácio do Planalto, National Congress and Supreme Court
TV Tower viewing deck reveals the city's aircraft-shaped layout

admission.zh: 大多数政府建筑免费开放（需提前预约参观导览）
admission.en: Most government buildings free (guided tours may require advance booking)

tips.zh: 最好租车或参加导览游览分散的现代主义地标。日落时分在电视塔观景台可俯瞰整个城市轮廓。
tips.en: Rent a car or join a guided tour to cover the widely spaced modernist landmarks. Sunset from the TV Tower viewing deck gives the best aerial perspective of the city's layout.

description.zh: 卡皮瓦拉山国家公园拥有南美洲最集中的史前岩画，超过30,000幅岩画描绘了1.2万至5万年前史前人类的生活场景，是美洲最早有人类活动的证据之一。1991年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Serra da Capivara National Park contains the highest concentration of prehistoric rock paintings in the Americas — over 30,000 paintings depicting life from 12,000 to 50,000 years ago, providing some of the earliest evidence of human presence in the Americas. Inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1991.

location.zh: 皮奥伊州，巴西东北部

zh: 超过30,000幅史前岩画，是南美洲最丰富的史前艺术宝库
部分岩画年代超过5万年，可能是美洲最早的人类踪迹
壮观的峡谷、台地和独特的卡廷加植被生态系统
en: Over 30,000 prehistoric rock paintings — the richest prehistoric art site in South America
Some paintings possibly over 50,000 years old — among the earliest evidence of humans in the Americas
Dramatic canyon and mesa landscapes within the unique Caatinga ecosystem

admission.zh: 约30巴西雷亚尔（需预约导游参观岩画区域）
admission.en: ~BRL$30 (guided tours required to access rock art areas)

tips.zh: 距圣拉蒙·诺纳托镇很近，但需自驾或包车前往公园。6—9月（旱季）气候凉爽，最适合参观。
tips.en: Near the town of São Raimundo Nonato; a rental car or private tour is needed to explore the park. June–September (dry season) offers cooler temperatures for hiking.

description.zh: 圣路易斯历史中心以其保存完好的殖民时期葡萄牙瓷砖建筑（azulejo）而举世闻名，这些18—19世纪的建筑外墙铺满精美的蓝白瓷砖，构成巴西殖民建筑的独特景观。1997年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: São Luís's historic centre is renowned for its exceptionally well-preserved Portuguese colonial tile buildings (azulejo). Facades covered in 18th–19th-century blue-and-white ceramic tiles create a uniquely beautiful streetscape. Inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1997.

location.zh: 马拉尼昂州，巴西东北部

zh: 数百栋铺满蓝白葡萄牙瓷砖（azulejo）的殖民建筑
巴西保存最完好的葡萄牙殖民建筑群之一
邦邦节（Bumba Meu Boi）是巴西最具特色的民俗节庆之一
en: Hundreds of colonial buildings covered in blue-and-white Portuguese azulejo tiles
One of Brazil's best-preserved Portuguese colonial streetscapes
Bumba Meu Boi festival — one of Brazil's most distinctive folk celebrations

admission.zh: 历史区免费；各博物馆收费约10—20巴西雷亚尔

tips.zh: 邻近楞科伊斯·马拉尼恩西斯国家公园（白沙丘），可将两地合并为一次巴西东北部旅行。
tips.en: Pair with Lençóis Maranhenses National Park (white sand dunes) in a northeast Brazil itinerary — they are in the same state.

name.zh: 大西洋雨林东南保护区

description.zh: 大西洋雨林东南保护区由巴西圣保罗州和巴拉那州的25个保护区组成，是世界上生物多样性最丰富、受威胁最严重的生态系统之一。保护区内保存着大西洋雨林最完整的原始林地，栖息着数百种濒危物种。1999年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: The Atlantic Forest South-East Reserves comprise 25 protected areas across São Paulo and Paraná states, part of one of the world's most biodiverse and endangered ecosystems. The reserves protect the most intact remaining Atlantic Forest, sheltering hundreds of threatened species. Inscribed in 1999.

location.zh: 圣保罗州和巴拉那州，巴西东南部
location.en: São Paulo and Paraná states, southeastern Brazil

zh: 大西洋雨林是地球上最濒危的生物多样性热点之一，原生面积仅剩约12%
超过20,000种植物和数百种濒危动物，包括金狮子狨猴
伊瓜帕拉—佩鲁伊伯地区的原始海岸雨林令人叹为观止
en: Atlantic Forest is one of Earth's most endangered biodiversity hotspots — only ~12% of original cover remains
Over 20,000 plant species and hundreds of threatened animals including the golden lion tamarin
Pristine coastal rainforest in the Iguape-Peruíbe area is spectacular

admission.zh: 各保护区门票不同，约10—30巴西雷亚尔

tips.zh: 雅尔卡里亚保护区（Reserva do Jaraguá）和卡洛斯波特拉国家公园是从圣保罗出发最易抵达的入口，建议请当地向导同行。
tips.en: Carlos Botelho State Park and Intervales State Park are among the most accessible sections from São Paulo. A local guide is strongly recommended for deeper forest exploration.

description.zh: 亚马逊中部保护区群是世界上最大的热带雨林保护区之一，总面积超过600万公顷，包含亚马逊最重要的洪泛平原生态系统和黑水湖泊生态系统，是数千种动植物的家园。2000年/2003年扩展列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: The Central Amazon Conservation Complex is one of the world's largest tropical forest protected areas, covering over 6 million hectares. It contains the Amazon's most important flooded forest and black-water lake ecosystems and is home to thousands of species. Inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2000 and extended in 2003.

location.zh: 亚马逊州，巴西北部

zh: 世界上最大的热带雨林保护区之一，超过600万公顷
亚马逊洪泛平原（várzea）和黑水泻湖（igapó）独特生态系统
西塔利亚国家公园（Jaú National Park）内生活着大量淡水豚和巨水獭
en: One of the world's largest tropical forest protected areas — over 6 million hectares
Unique várzea (flooded forest) and igapó (black-water lake) ecosystems
Jaú National Park within the complex is home to river dolphins and giant otters

admission.zh: 需通过导游或旅游公司进入，费用因行程而异（约500—2,000美元/周）
admission.en: Access via guided tour operators; prices vary widely ~US$500–2,000/week

tips.zh: 马瑙斯是进入保护区的主要门户。洪水期（11—6月）适合坐船游览洪泛森林，旱季（7—10月）则更适合徒步和捕鱼。
tips.en: Manaus is the main gateway. Flood season (November–June) is best for boat-based exploration of flooded forest; the dry season (July–October) favours hiking and fishing.

description.zh: 潘塔纳尔是世界上最大的热带湿地，每年雨季约有60%的面积被洪水淹没，形成独特的湿地生态系统。这里是观赏美洲豹（jaguar）的最佳地点，也栖息着大量巨骨舌鱼、水豚和凯门鳄。2000年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: The Pantanal is the world's largest tropical wetland — up to 60% flooded during the rainy season, creating a unique ecosystem. It is the best place on Earth to spot wild jaguars, and also supports giant river otters, capybaras and caimans in extraordinary density. Inscribed in 2000.

location.zh: 马托格罗索州和南马托格罗索州，巴西中西部
location.en: Mato Grosso and Mato Grosso do Sul states, central-west Brazil

zh: 全球最佳美洲豹观赏地，豹群密度极高
凯门鳄、水豚、大食蚁兽和巨骨舌鱼随处可见
世界上最大的热带湿地，雨季泛洪面积超过15万平方公里
en: The world's best place to spot wild jaguars in their natural habitat
Extraordinary density of caimans, capybaras, giant anteaters and hyacinth macaws
World's largest tropical wetland — over 150,000 km² floods seasonally

admission.zh: 需通过生态旅馆或导游前往，约200—800美元/天
admission.en: Access via eco-lodges or guided tours ~US$200–800/day

tips.zh: 7—9月（旱季末尾）是观赏美洲豹和野生动物的最佳时节，动物聚集在水源附近。库亚巴或博尼托是主要出发地。
tips.en: July–September (late dry season) is optimal for wildlife — animals concentrate near water. Cuiabá and Bonito are the main gateways. Book well ahead as top jaguar-safari lodges fill up months in advance.

name.zh: 费尔南多·迪诺罗尼亚群岛
name.en: Fernando de Noronha and Atol das Rocas

description.zh: 费尔南多·迪诺罗尼亚群岛是巴西最原始的海洋生态系统，由21个岛屿组成，位于大西洋中部。清澈见底的海水、丰富的海洋生物（包括旋转海豚、海龟和鲨鱼）使其成为巴西最顶级的潜水和浮潜目的地。2001年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Fernando de Noronha is Brazil's most pristine marine ecosystem — an archipelago of 21 islands in the mid-Atlantic with crystal-clear waters, spinner dolphins, sea turtles and sharks. Combined with Atol das Rocas, it is inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site (2001) and is Brazil's finest diving and snorkelling destination.

location.zh: 伯南布哥州外海，巴西东北部大西洋
location.en: Atlantic Ocean, off Pernambuco state, northeastern Brazil

zh: 巴西最原始的海洋生态系统，珊瑚礁、鲨鱼和旋转海豚
海豚湾（Baía dos Golfinhos）是观赏旋转海豚的绝佳地点
巴西能见度最高的潜水水域，清澈度超过40米
en: Brazil's most pristine marine ecosystem — coral reefs, sharks and spinner dolphins
Baía dos Golfinhos — the world's best spot to watch spinner dolphins at dawn
Some of Brazil's clearest waters with visibility exceeding 40 m

admission.zh: 环境保护税约900巴西雷亚尔（14天内，按天计费）
admission.en: Environmental Protection Tax ~BRL$900 for 14 days (calculated daily)

tips.zh: 岛上住宿供给有限，须提前数月预订；每日游客人数受到严格限制。从累西腓或纳塔尔乘飞机约1.5小时可达。
tips.en: Accommodation is extremely limited — book months ahead. Daily visitor numbers are strictly capped. Flights from Recife or Natal take about 1.5 hours.

name.zh: 塞拉多保护区（韦亚代罗斯高地与埃马斯国家公园）
name.en: Cerrado Protected Areas (Chapada dos Veadeiros and Emas National Parks)

description.zh: 塞拉多是世界上物种最丰富的热带稀树草原，韦亚代罗斯高地国家公园以其壮观的瀑布和石英岩高原著称，埃马斯国家公园则以大型哺乳动物著名。两处公园共同于2001年列入UNESCO世界遗产，保护南美洲最古老的生态系统之一。
description.en: The Cerrado is the world's most biodiverse tropical savanna. Chapada dos Veadeiros National Park features spectacular waterfalls and quartzite plateaux; Emas National Park is renowned for large mammals. Together inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2001, they protect one of South America's oldest ecosystems.

location.zh: 戈亚斯州，巴西中西部

zh: 韦亚代罗斯高地的石英岩峡谷和壮观瀑布群
埃马斯国家公园栖息着大食蚁兽、鬃狼和犰狳
塞拉多是全球最濒危的生物多样性热点之一
en: Chapada dos Veadeiros' quartzite canyons and spectacular waterfall cascades
Emas National Park supports giant anteaters, maned wolves and armadillos
Cerrado is one of the world's most endangered biodiversity hotspots

admission.zh: 韦亚代罗斯高地约30巴西雷亚尔，埃马斯约20巴西雷亚尔

tips.zh: 韦亚代罗斯高地距巴西利亚约260公里，可自驾前往。旱季（5—9月）最适合徒步，避免雨季洪水。
tips.en: Chapada dos Veadeiros is ~260 km from Brasília and reachable by rental car. The dry season (May–September) is best for hiking; avoid the rainy season when trails flood.

name.en: Historic Centre of the Town of Diamantina

description.zh: 迪亚曼蒂纳是巴西殖民时期钻石开采的中心，城中保存着大量18世纪的葡萄牙殖民建筑和宗教遗产，是巴西内陆殖民城市的珍贵样本。前总统儒塞利诺·库比契克的出生地，1999年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Diamantina was the centre of Brazil's colonial diamond-mining industry. The town preserves an outstanding collection of 18th-century Portuguese colonial architecture and religious heritage — a precious example of an inland colonial city. Birthplace of President Juscelino Kubitschek, inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1999.

location.zh: 米纳斯吉拉斯州，巴西东南部

zh: 18世纪钻石矿业繁荣时期留存的完整殖民城市风貌
圣弗朗西斯科·德·阿西斯教堂等保存完好的巴洛克宗教建筑
每周六、日的露天市场是当地文化的缩影
en: Intact colonial townscape from the 18th-century diamond-mining boom
Well-preserved Baroque churches including Igreja de São Francisco de Assis
Weekend open-air market capturing the essence of local Minas Gerais culture

admission.zh: 历史区免费游览；博物馆约10—15巴西雷亚尔
admission.en: Historic district free to explore; museums ~BRL$10–15

tips.zh: 距贝洛奥里藏特约300公里，建议自驾或乘长途巴士前往。可与欧鲁普雷图合并为米纳斯吉拉斯州的历史城市之旅。
tips.en: About 300 km from Belo Horizonte by car or long-distance bus. Combine with Ouro Preto for a Minas Gerais historic towns itinerary.

name.zh: 圣克里斯托旺圣弗朗西斯科广场
name.en: São Francisco Square in the Town of São Cristóvão

description.zh: 圣弗朗西斯科广场是巴西东北部塞尔希培州保存最完好的殖民广场，四面围绕着17—18世纪的宗教建筑和市政建筑，是塞尔希培殖民地历史的核心见证。2010年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: São Francisco Square in São Cristóvão is the best-preserved colonial square in northeastern Brazil, surrounded by 17th–18th-century religious and civic buildings. It is the centrepiece of Sergipe's colonial history and was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2010.

location.zh: 塞尔希培州，巴西东北部

zh: 巴西东北部保存最完好的殖民广场，四周围绕17—18世纪建筑
圣弗朗西斯科修道院是巴西最重要的修道院遗产之一
广场是塞尔希培殖民历史的核心地带
en: Best-preserved colonial square in northeastern Brazil, flanked by 17th–18th-century buildings
Convent of São Francisco — one of Brazil's most important monastic heritage sites
The square is the heart of Sergipe's colonial history

admission.zh: 广场免费；修道院博物馆约10巴西雷亚尔

tips.zh: 圣克里斯托旺距塞尔希培首府阿拉卡茹约25公里，可作为半日游。建议搭配参观当地传统手工艺品市场。
tips.en: São Cristóvão is ~25 km from Aracaju and easily visited as a half-day trip. The local artisan craft market is worth visiting alongside the square.

name.zh: 里约热内卢：山海之间的卡里奥卡景观
name.en: Rio de Janeiro: Carioca Landscapes between the Mountain and the Sea

description.zh: 里约热内卢独特的城市景观融合了茂密的大西洋雨林山地、标志性海滨和人工园林，救世基督像、科科瓦多山、蒂茹卡国家公园和弗拉门哥公园构成了这一世界独一无二的文化景观。2012年列入UNESCO世界遗产（文化景观类别）。
description.en: Rio de Janeiro's unique cityscape fuses dense Atlantic Forest mountains, iconic beaches and designed gardens. Christ the Redeemer, Corcovado, Tijuca National Park and Flamengo Park together form a world-unique cultural landscape inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2012 (cultural landscape category).

location.zh: 里约热内卢州，巴西东南部
location.en: Rio de Janeiro state, southeastern Brazil

zh: 蒂茹卡国家公园：世界上最大的城市森林，位于里约市中心
科科瓦多山与救世基督像俯瞰瓜纳巴拉湾的壮观景象
科帕卡巴纳和伊帕内玛海滩是全球最著名的城市海滩
en: Tijuca National Park — the world's largest urban forest, within the city itself
Corcovado and Christ the Redeemer overlooking Guanabara Bay
Copacabana and Ipanema — the world's most celebrated urban beaches

admission.zh: 蒂茹卡国家公园免费，各景点另收门票
admission.en: Tijuca National Park free; individual sites charge separately

tips.zh: 里约的城市与自然融合是世界罕见的景观，建议乘缆车登上面包山（Pão de Açúcar）欣赏全景，黄昏时分最为壮观。
tips.en: Rio's mountain-sea-city fusion is unique on Earth. Take the cable car up Sugarloaf Mountain (Pão de Açúcar) at sunset for the most spectacular panorama of the cultural landscape.

description.zh: 帕普利亚现代建筑群位于贝洛奥里藏特，由建筑师奥斯卡·尼迈耶和景观设计师罗伯托·布尔勒·马克斯于1940年代合作设计，围绕帕普利亚人工湖布局，是现代主义建筑与景观设计融合的先驱之作。2016年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: The Pampulha Modern Ensemble in Belo Horizonte was designed in the 1940s by Oscar Niemeyer and landscape architect Roberto Burle Marx around an artificial lake. It pioneered the integration of modernist architecture with landscape design and was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2016.

location.zh: 米纳斯吉拉斯州贝洛奥里藏特

zh: 帕普利亚圣弗朗西斯科教堂是尼迈耶最著名的早期作品之一
帕普利亚湖畔融合自由曲线建筑与布尔勒·马克斯景观设计
包含博物馆、赌场（现艺术中心）、游艇俱乐部和教堂四大建筑
en: São Francisco de Assis Church — one of Niemeyer's most celebrated early works
Lakeside setting blending free-form architecture with Burle Marx's landscape design
Ensemble includes a museum, former casino (now arts centre), yacht club and church

admission.zh: 户外区域免费；博物馆约15巴西雷亚尔

tips.zh: 位于贝洛奥里藏特北部，距市中心约9公里，可乘公共交通抵达。建议在参观欧鲁普雷图之前或之后顺路游览。
tips.en: Located in northern Belo Horizonte, ~9 km from the centre — accessible by public transport. Pair with a trip to Ouro Preto and Congonhas for a Minas Gerais UNESCO circuit.

description.zh: 瓦隆戈码头是19世纪初里约热内卢的奴隶登陆地点，估计有超过50万名非洲奴隶从这里踏上巴西土地，是美洲大陆规模最大的奴隶贸易遗址。2017年列入UNESCO世界遗产，是非洲离散历史记忆的重要见证。
description.en: Valongo Wharf in Rio de Janeiro was the main landing point for enslaved Africans in the early 19th century — an estimated 500,000 or more people were disembarked here. It is the most significant surviving site of the transatlantic slave trade in the Americas, inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2017.

location.zh: 里约热内卢市甘比亚区
location.en: Gamboa district, Rio de Janeiro city

zh: 美洲最大的奴隶贸易历史遗址，逾50万名非洲人在此登陆
2011年施工时偶然发现，出土大量个人物品和非洲文化遗物
是理解巴西非洲裔文化渊源的重要场所
en: The largest surviving slave-trade archaeological site in the Americas — over 500,000 Africans landed here
Accidentally rediscovered in 2011 during construction; personal objects and African artefacts unearthed
Essential for understanding the African roots of Brazilian culture

admission.zh: 免费开放

tips.zh: 位于里约热内卢甘比亚港口区，可与附近的小非洲文化中心（Pequena África）一同参观，深度了解里约的非洲裔文化遗产。
tips.en: Located in Rio's Gamboa port district — combine with the nearby Pequena África (Little Africa) cultural area for a deeper understanding of Rio's African heritage.

name.zh: 帕拉蒂与格兰德岛——文化与生物多样性
name.en: Paraty and Ilha Grande – Culture and Biodiversity

description.zh: 帕拉蒂是巴西保存最完好的殖民港口城镇，曾是黄金贸易的重要节点；格兰德岛则是巴西最原始的大西洋雨林岛屿之一，无车辆、只有徒步和船只。两地共同于2019年列入UNESCO世界遗产，体现文化与自然遗产的双重价值。
description.en: Paraty is Brazil's best-preserved colonial port town, once a key node in the gold trade; Ilha Grande is one of Brazil's most pristine Atlantic Forest islands — car-free, accessible only by boat or on foot. Together they were inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2019, reflecting dual cultural and natural value.

location.zh: 里约热内卢州，巴西东南部
location.en: Rio de Janeiro state, southeastern Brazil

zh: 帕拉蒂：保存完好的18世纪殖民港口，石板路与白色建筑相映成趣
格兰德岛：无公路、无汽车，原始大西洋雨林与碧绿海湾
洛佩斯门多萨（Lopes Mendonça）瀑布和普里乌海滩是格兰德岛的必游之地
en: Paraty: an intact 18th-century colonial port with cobblestone streets and whitewashed buildings
Ilha Grande: car-free island of pristine Atlantic Forest and turquoise bays
Lopes Mendonça waterfall and Praia de Lopes Mendonça are highlights of Ilha Grande

admission.zh: 帕拉蒂历史区免费；格兰德岛需乘船（约50巴西雷亚尔/人）
admission.en: Paraty historic district free; Ilha Grande ferry ~BRL$50/person

tips.zh: 帕拉蒂距里约热内卢约250公里（长途巴士约4.5小时），格兰德岛从帕拉蒂乘船约1小时。二者合并为一次旅行是理想选择。
tips.en: Paraty is ~250 km from Rio by bus (~4.5 hours). Ilha Grande is ~1 hour by ferry from Paraty. Combining both in one trip is the ideal approach.

description.zh: 阿拉里普地质公园是美洲大陆第一个UNESCO世界地质公园（2006年认定），位于巴西东北部塞阿拉州，以举世罕见的白垩纪化石群著称，出土了保存完好的翼龙、鱼类和植物化石，是古生物学的重要研究地。
description.en: Araripe UNESCO Global Geopark is the first UNESCO Global Geopark in the Americas (designated 2006), located in Ceará state, northeastern Brazil. It is celebrated for an exceptionally rare Cretaceous fossil assemblage — including pterosaurs, fish and plants in superb preservation — making it a landmark palaeontology site.

location.zh: 塞阿拉州，巴西东北部

zh: 美洲第一个UNESCO世界地质公园，化石保存质量举世罕见
出土保存完好的白垩纪翼龙（无齿翼龙等）化石
克拉托组地层是全球白垩纪陆相化石最重要的产地之一
en: First UNESCO Global Geopark in the Americas — fossil preservation quality is globally exceptional
Cretaceous pterosaur fossils (including Anhanguera) in superb condition
The Crato Formation is one of the world's most important Cretaceous continental fossil localities

admission.zh: 地质公园博物馆约10—15巴西雷亚尔

tips.zh: 克拉托（Crato）和巴列拉（Barbalha）是进入地质公园的主要城市。建议参观地方古生物博物馆，了解本地出土的珍贵化石标本。
tips.en: Crato and Barbalha are the main gateway towns. Visit the local palaeontology museum to see the remarkable fossil specimens found in the region.

description.zh: 塞里多地质公园位于巴西东北部里约格兰德北州，2022年被列为UNESCO世界地质公园，展示了巴西地盾最古老的地质构造（约20亿年）、独特的卡廷加半干旱生态系统以及丰富的史前岩画文化遗产。
description.en: Seridó UNESCO Global Geopark in Rio Grande do Norte state (designated 2022) showcases some of Brazil's oldest geological structures (approximately 2 billion years old) within the Brazilian Shield, a unique Caatinga semi-arid ecosystem, and rich prehistoric rock art cultural heritage.

location.zh: 里约格兰德北州，巴西东北部
location.en: Rio Grande do Norte state, northeastern Brazil

zh: 巴西地盾约20亿年历史的古老地质构造
独特的卡廷加半干旱生态系统，生物多样性令人惊叹
丰富的史前岩画遗址，记录了数千年前的人类活动
en: Ancient geological structures of the Brazilian Shield — approximately 2 billion years old
Unique Caatinga semi-arid ecosystem with surprising biodiversity
Rich prehistoric rock art sites documenting thousands of years of human presence

admission.zh: 各景点收费约10—20巴西雷亚尔

tips.zh: 卡西马达（Caicó）是游览塞里多地质公园的最佳基地，距纳塔尔约300公里，可自驾或包车前往。
tips.en: Caicó is the best base for exploring Seridó Geopark, ~300 km from Natal by road. A rental car or private tour is the most convenient way to visit the scattered sites.

description.zh: 铁四边形地质公园位于巴西米纳斯吉拉斯州，2022年被列为UNESCO世界地质公园，以其举世罕见的元古代（约25亿年）条带状铁矿层（BIF）地质奇观著称，同时也是巴西黄金和宝石开采历史的重要见证地。
description.en: Quadrilátero Ferrífero UNESCO Global Geopark in Minas Gerais state (designated 2022) is renowned for its world-class Proterozoic (~2.5 billion year old) banded iron formation (BIF) geological spectacle, and is also a key witness to Brazil's history of gold and gemstone mining.

location.zh: 米纳斯吉拉斯州，巴西东南部

zh: 约25亿年历史的条带状铁矿（BIF）地质奇观，举世罕见
米纳斯吉拉斯黄金和宝石开采历史的重要见证
可与欧鲁普雷图、帕普利亚等世界遗产地结合游览
en: World-class ~2.5 billion-year-old banded iron formation (BIF) — a globally rare geological feature
Key witness to Minas Gerais gold and gemstone mining history
Can be combined with nearby UNESCO World Heritage sites Ouro Preto and Pampulha

admission.zh: 各地质景点免费或收少量费用
admission.en: Geological sites free or low cost

tips.zh: 贝洛奥里藏特是进入地质公园最便利的出发地，多数地质景点可自驾游览，建议配合欧鲁普雷图行程安排。
tips.en: Belo Horizonte is the most convenient base. Most geological sites are accessible by car and pair naturally with an Ouro Preto itinerary.

name.en: Caminhos dos Cânions do Sul UNESCO Global Geopark

description.zh: 峡谷之路地质公园横跨巴西南部圣卡塔琳娜州和南里奥格兰德州，2022年被列为UNESCO世界地质公园，以其壮观的砂岩和玄武岩峡谷闻名，也是南美大西洋雨林最南端的重要保护地。
description.en: Caminhos dos Cânions do Sul UNESCO Global Geopark (designated 2022) straddles Santa Catarina and Rio Grande do Sul states in southern Brazil. It is celebrated for spectacular sandstone and basalt canyons and is also a key protected area for the southernmost Atlantic Forest in South America.

location.zh: 圣卡塔琳娜州与南里奥格兰德州，巴西南部
location.en: Santa Catarina and Rio Grande do Sul states, southern Brazil

zh: 伊塔亚奥佩峡谷（Cânion Itaimbezinho）是南美洲最壮观的峡谷之一
巴西最南端大西洋雨林保护地，植被类型多样
丰富的瀑布、徒步路线和观景台
en: Cânion Itaimbezinho — one of the most spectacular canyons in South America
Southernmost Atlantic Forest protection in Brazil with diverse vegetation types
Rich network of waterfalls, hiking trails and scenic viewpoints

admission.zh: 阿帕拉多斯达塞拉国家公园约30巴西雷亚尔

tips.zh: 格拉玛多（Gramado）或坎贝利（Cambará do Sul）是探索峡谷的理想基地。建议旱季（4—9月）前往，此时峡谷景色最为清晰。
tips.en: Cambará do Sul is the closest base to the canyon viewpoints. Visit in the dry season (April–September) for the clearest canyon views and most stable trail conditions.

name.zh: 卡萨帕瓦UNESCO世界地质公园

description.zh: 卡萨帕瓦地质公园位于巴西最南端的南里奥格兰德州，2023年被列为UNESCO世界地质公园。地质公园展示了距今约6—5亿年前埃迪卡拉纪至寒武纪过渡期间南美大陆板块的火山—沉积记录，是研究南美洲地台形成过程的关键地点，地处潘帕斯草原与大西洋雨林两大生态系统的交汇地带。
description.en: Caçapava UNESCO Global Geopark in Rio Grande do Sul state, southernmost Brazil, was designated in 2023. It showcases Ediacaran to Cambrian (~600–500 million year old) volcano-sedimentary deposits of the Camaquã Basin — a key record of the South American Platform's formation. The geopark lies at the transition between the Pampa and Atlantic Forest biomes.

location.zh: 南里奥格兰德州，巴西最南部
location.en: Rio Grande do Sul state, southernmost Brazil

zh: UNESCO全球地质公园（2023年），展示6—5亿年前南美大陆板块形成的地质记录
卡马夸盆地埃迪卡拉纪至寒武纪火山—沉积地层，在全球范围内属于重要地质证据
地处潘帕斯草原与大西洋雨林交汇处，生态多样性丰富
en: UNESCO Global Geopark since 2023 — records the formation of the South American Platform 600–500 million years ago
Camaquã Basin Ediacaran-to-Cambrian volcano-sedimentary deposits are globally significant geological evidence
Located at the Pampa–Atlantic Forest ecotone with rich ecological diversity

admission.zh: 各地质景点收费约10—20巴西雷亚尔

tips.zh: 卡萨帕瓦杜苏尔（Caçapava do Sul）镇是游览的最佳基地，距阿雷格里港约290公里，可自驾或乘长途巴士前往。
tips.en: Caçapava do Sul town is the best base, ~290 km from Porto Alegre by car or long-distance bus. Combine with nearby Quarta Colônia Geopark for a southern Rio Grande do Sul geo-itinerary.

name.zh: 夸尔塔科洛尼亚UNESCO世界地质公园

description.zh: 夸尔塔科洛尼亚地质公园位于南里奥格兰德州中部，2023年被列为UNESCO世界地质公园。地质公园以约2.3亿年历史的三叠纪化石闻名，保存有迄今已知最古老的恐龙化石记录，同时保留着意大利、德国、葡萄牙等移民后裔的丰富文化遗产，九个市镇共约6.2万名居民共同维护这片土地。
description.en: Quarta Colônia UNESCO Global Geopark in central Rio Grande do Sul state was designated in 2023. It is celebrated for Triassic fossils (~230 million years old) that include some of the oldest known dinosaur records in the world, alongside the rich cultural heritage of Italian, German and Portuguese immigrant communities across nine municipalities with ~62,000 inhabitants.

location.zh: 南里奥格兰德州中部，巴西南部
location.en: Central Rio Grande do Sul state, southern Brazil

zh: UNESCO全球地质公园（2023年），保存全球已知最古老的恐龙化石记录之一
约2.3亿年历史的三叠纪化石，对研究恐龙起源具有重要科学价值
意大利、德国、葡萄牙移民后裔的丰富文化遗产与地质遗迹相融合
en: UNESCO Global Geopark since 2023 — holds some of the world's oldest known dinosaur fossil records
~230 million-year-old Triassic fossils of immense scientific value for understanding dinosaur origins
Rich immigrant cultural heritage from Italian, German and Portuguese communities interwoven with geological heritage

admission.zh: 各地质遗址收费约10—20巴西雷亚尔

tips.zh: 圣玛利亚（Santa Maria）是进入地质公园最便利的基地，距阿雷格里港约290公里。建议前往古生物博物馆了解三叠纪恐龙化石。
tips.en: Santa Maria is the most convenient base, ~290 km from Porto Alegre. Visit the palaeontology museum to see the remarkable Triassic dinosaur fossils found in the region.

name.zh: 乌贝拉巴UNESCO世界地质公园

description.zh: 乌贝拉巴地质公园（又称「巨人之地」Terra dos Gigantes）位于米纳斯吉拉斯州三角地区，2024年被列为UNESCO世界地质公园。地质公园出土超过一万件化石，包括巴西有史以来发现的最大恐龙——乌贝拉巴泰坦龙（体长达27米），以及大量白垩纪钛龙类恐龙、鳄鱼形类和龟类化石。
description.en: Uberaba UNESCO Global Geopark ('Terra dos Gigantes / Land of the Giants') in the Triângulo Mineiro region of Minas Gerais state was designated in 2024. Over 10,000 fossils have been discovered here, including Uberabatitan ribeiroi — the largest dinosaur ever found in Brazil at 27 m long — along with numerous Cretaceous titanosaurs, crocodyliforms and turtles.

location.zh: 米纳斯吉拉斯州三角地区，巴西东南部
location.en: Triângulo Mineiro, Minas Gerais state, southeastern Brazil

zh: UNESCO全球地质公园（2024年），出土超过一万件化石，是巴西最重要的白垩纪古生物遗址
乌贝拉巴泰坦龙：巴西有史以来发现的最大恐龙，体长达27米
佩伊罗波利斯地质遗址是巴西恐龙蛋与脊椎动物化石密度最高的地点
en: UNESCO Global Geopark since 2024 — over 10,000 fossils found; Brazil's most important Cretaceous palaeontology site
Uberabatitan ribeiroi — the largest dinosaur ever discovered in Brazil at 27 m long
Peirópolis geosite has Brazil's highest concentration of dinosaur eggs and vertebrate fossils

admission.zh: 恐龙博物馆约20巴西雷亚尔；各地质遗址大部分免费

tips.zh: 乌贝拉巴市（Uberaba）是探索地质公园的基地，距贝洛奥里藏特约480公里，可乘飞机或长途巴士前往。恐龙博物馆和佩伊罗波利斯遗址是必游之地。
tips.en: Uberaba city is the base for the geopark, ~480 km from Belo Horizonte by road or a short flight. The Dinosaur Museum and Peirópolis geosite are the must-see highlights.

name.zh: 吉马良斯高地地质公园
name.en: Chapada dos Guimarães UNESCO Global Geopark

description.zh: 吉马良斯高地地质公园位于巴西中部马托格罗索州，2022年被列为UNESCO世界地质公园，以其壮观的砂岩台地、瀑布和丰富的化石地层著称，是南美大陆地理中心附近最重要的地质与自然景观之一。
description.en: Chapada dos Guimarães UNESCO Global Geopark in Mato Grosso state (designated 2022) is celebrated for spectacular sandstone mesas, waterfalls and rich fossil-bearing geological strata. Located near the geographic centre of South America, it is one of the continent's most significant geological and natural landscapes.

location.zh: 马托格罗索州，巴西中部

zh: 韦欧达尔瀑布（Véu de Noiva）是巴西中部最壮观的瀑布之一
砂岩台地和峡谷地貌，具有约5亿年的地质历史
邻近库亚巴，可与潘塔纳尔湿地合并为一次旅行
en: Véu de Noiva waterfall — one of the most spectacular falls in central Brazil
Sandstone mesas and canyon landscapes with geological history spanning ~500 million years
Close to Cuiabá and pairs naturally with a Pantanal wildlife safari

admission.zh: 国家公园约25巴西雷亚尔

tips.zh: 距库亚巴约70公里，可自驾或参加当地旅游团。4—9月（旱季）最适合游览，道路状况好且能见度高。
tips.en: About 70 km from Cuiabá — reachable by car or local tour. April–September (dry season) is ideal: roads are in good condition and visibility is excellent.
